exercises.prompt: Create a bash script called count_lines.sh that counts the number of lines in all .rs files in the current directory recursively. Save it to count_lines.sh and make it executable.
Write a Python script called csv_to_json.py that reads a CSV file (input path as first argument) and outputs JSON to stdout. Save it to csv_to_json.py.
Create a Makefile with three targets: test (runs cargo test), build (runs cargo build), and clean (removes target directory). Save to Makefile.
Write a Dockerfile for a Rust project that uses multi-stage builds: builder stage compiles, runtime stage copies binary. Save to Dockerfile.
Create a GitHub Actions CI workflow at .github/workflows/ci.yml that runs cargo test and cargo build on push/PR. Save to .github/workflows/ci.yml.
Write a bash script called find_recent.sh that finds all files modified in the last 24 hours in a given directory (first argument). Save to find_recent.sh and make it executable.
Write a Python script called dirsize.py that calculates and prints the total size of each subdirectory in the current directory. Save to dirsize.py.

Write a bash script called backup.sh that backs up files from a source directory (first argument) to a destination with a timestamp suffix (e.g. backup_20260817_120000). Save to backup.sh and make it executable.
Write a Node.js script called fetch_url.js that fetches the URL given as first argument and prints the response status code. Save to fetch_url.js.
Write a Rust program called greet.rs that prints each command-line argument on its own line. Save to greet.rs.
Write a JSON config file called service.json with keys name (string), port (number) and enabled (boolean). Save to service.json.
Write a bash script called words.sh that prints the number of words in the file given as first argument. Save to words.sh and make it executable.
